arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS joined_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS attribute_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.team_api_id) AS teams, COUNT(t.id) AS matched_rows,
       MIN(a.date) AS first_date, MAX(a.date) AS last_date,
       MIN(a.buildUpPlayPassing) AS min_score, MAX(a.buildUpPlayPassing) AS max_score
FROM Team_Attributes AS a
LEFT JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = a.team_api_id
WHERE a.date >= '2012-01-01' AND a.date < '2013-01-01'

WITH passing_2012 AS (
    SELECT team_api_id, buildUpPlayPassing
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE date >= '2012-01-01' AND date < '2013-01-01'
)
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM passing_2012 AS p
JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = p.team_api_id
WHERE p.buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) FROM passing_2012)
ORDER BY t.team_long_name
